description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Sitinamaluwa, Beliatta D/S Division, Hambantota District (25/0089)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and property ownership matters. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including owner names, parcel numbers, extents, and encumbrances. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, and does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
